answer: Admission proof-of-work at the gate: each identity must burn a puzzle costing ~4 CPU-hours (≈$0.30 spot). The vine of referrals can't shortcut it — every branch re-mines. A voyage to 1,000 sybils costs 4,000 CPU-hours (~$300) and scales linearly, no discount. The fable that farming is cheap dies at that price. Works because cost per identity stays fixed while attacker gain per identity shrinks.
